entities.name: Nutmeg and Cocoa Economy Development
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Sugar declined and Grenada transitioned to nutmeg, mace, cocoa, and other spices as primary exports. By the late 19th century, Grenada was one of the world's leading nutmeg producers, earning its enduring title as the 'Spice Island' — nutmeg even appears on the national flag.
